text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I've already taken care of making my first 
appearance to the everyone in the 
audience. So, from next year onwards――

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
The battle of a lifetime! Now, it's time 
for my Classic battlefield to begin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, how shall we rush forward into 
the Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, it's make-or-break!? Going 
straight in, zero prep, would be pretty 
Bakushin-esque, wouldn't it!
choice_data_list: Isn't that a little too Bakushin-esque!?

text_block_list.text:
As one might expect, the Satsuki Sho is 
much too abrupt of a challenge, so if we 
just follow the original plan, the first 
race would be…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh―! That is a race for the very best Uma 
Musume, in anticipation of the Satsuki 
Sho!

Spring Stakes, 1800 meters. It's a long 
distance for Sakura Bakushin O, but it'll 
give her time to think before Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yes, yes, this is an honor student's 
choice race!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, next stop, the Spring Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
With my speed, I can run 1800 meters in an 
instant!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If it's been decided! I need to train for 
middle distances ASAP!
